subject: FAR
title: Bank Reconciliation and Adjusting Entries
scenario:
Kestrel Manufacturing Co. maintains its operating cash account with Harborview National Bank. The company prepares a bank reconciliation at the end of each month and records any adjusting or correcting entries indicated by the reconciliation.

You have been asked to prepare the December 31, Year 1 bank reconciliation for the operating account and to record the related journal entries.

Refer to the December bank statement summary in **Exhibit 1**, the company's cash records in **Exhibit 2**, and the additional information in **Exhibit 3**. Complete each work tab below.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1: Bank Statement Summary — December
exhibits.content:
**Harborview National Bank — Statement of Account**
**Kestrel Manufacturing Co., Operating Account No. 4471, for the month ended December 31, Year 1**

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Balance, December 1, Year 1 | $74,300 |
| Deposits and other credits | 205,610 |
| Checks and other debits | (193,490) |
| **Balance, December 31, Year 1** | **$86,420** |

**Selected items appearing on the December statement:**

| Date | Description | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Dec 22 | Check No. 5521 paid | $1,100 |
| Dec 27 | Returned item — NSF | $2,840 |
| Dec 28 | Credit memo — note collected for depositor (principal $6,000; interest $240) | $6,240 |
| Dec 31 | Service charges for December | $85 |

exhibits.title: Exhibit 2: Company Cash Records
exhibits.content:
**Kestrel Manufacturing Co. — Cash records for Operating Account No. 4471**

The general ledger balance of the operating cash account at December 31, Year 1 is **$81,105**, before any adjustments arising from the December bank reconciliation.

1. Cash receipts of $12,650 for December 31 were placed in the bank's night depository after banking hours on December 31, Year 1, and do not appear on the December bank statement.
2. The following checks written in December had not cleared the bank as of December 31, Year 1:

| Check No. | Amount |
|---|---|
| 2301 | $4,730 |
| 2315 | 8,200 |
| 2320 | 3,000 |
| **Total** | **$15,930** |

3. Check No. 2318, written on December 15 to Marlowe Office Supply in payment of an account payable, was correctly written for $970 but was recorded in the cash disbursements journal as $790. The check cleared the bank in December at $970.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 3: Additional Information
exhibits.content:
1. The credit memo on the December bank statement represents the bank's collection, at maturity on December 28, of a $6,000, 8%, six-month note receivable from a customer, Ridgeline Cabinetworks, plus $240 of interest. Kestrel had not recorded the collection before receiving the bank statement.
2. The returned item is a $2,840 check from a customer, Brightbay Interiors, that Kestrel had received on account and deposited on December 18. The check was returned marked NSF on December 27. Kestrel will pursue collection from the customer.
3. Check No. 5521 for $1,100, charged against Kestrel's account on December 22, was drawn by Kestrel Supply Co., an unrelated company. Harborview National Bank has confirmed that the check was charged to Kestrel's account in error and will correct the error on the January statement.
4. Kestrel maintains a $150,000 revolving line of credit with Harborview National Bank bearing interest at prime plus 1.5%. The line was unused throughout December.
5. On November 1, Year 1, Kestrel purchased a $25,000 six-month certificate of deposit maturing April 30, Year 2. The certificate is recorded in the short-term investments account.
6. On January 3, Year 2, Kestrel received a $4,500 wire transfer from a customer in payment of a December invoice.

tasks.title: Bank Reconciliation — Balance per Bank
tasks.instruction: Using Exhibits 1 through 3, complete the bank section of the December 31, Year 1 bank reconciliation for the operating account. Enter additions as positive numbers and deductions as negative numbers (in whole dollars, no commas).

rows: Check of Kestrel Supply Co. charged in error

cells.rowLabel: Check of Kestrel Supply Co. charged in error

tasks.explanation: The balance per the bank statement is $86,420. The December 31 receipts of $12,650 placed in the night depository are a deposit in transit and are added because the bank has not yet recorded them. Outstanding checks of $15,930 ($4,730 + $8,200 + $3,000) are deducted because they have been recorded by the company but have not yet cleared the bank. The $1,100 check drawn by Kestrel Supply Co. was charged to Kestrel's account by the bank in error, so it is added back to the bank balance. Adjusted cash balance per bank = $86,420 + $12,650 − $15,930 + $1,100 = $84,240.

tasks.title: Bank Reconciliation — Balance per Books
tasks.instruction: Using Exhibits 1 through 3, complete the book section of the December 31, Year 1 bank reconciliation for the operating account. Enter additions as positive numbers and deductions as negative numbers (in whole dollars, no commas).

rows: Note receivable collected by bank, including interest

cells.rowLabel: Note receivable collected by bank, including interest

tasks.explanation: The balance per books is $81,105. The note receivable of $6,000 plus interest of $240 collected by the bank ($6,240 in total) is added because the bank has recorded the collection but the company has not. The $2,840 NSF check is deducted because the deposit did not clear. Bank service charges of $85 are deducted. Check No. 2318 was recorded at $790 instead of the correct amount of $970, so cash disbursements were understated by $180, which is deducted. Adjusted cash balance per books = $81,105 + $6,240 − $2,840 − $85 − $180 = $84,240, which agrees with the adjusted cash balance per bank.
tasks.explanationJa:
帳簿残高側の調整は、「会社がまだ記録していない項目」と「会社側の記帳誤り」です。

| 項目 | 金額 | 調整 |
|---|---|---|
| 帳簿残高（12/31） | $81,105 | — |
| 銀行による手形取立（元本$6,000 + 利息$240） | $6,240 | **加算** |
| NSF小切手（Brightbay Interiors） | $2,840 | **減算** |
| 銀行手数料 | $85 | **減算** |
| 小切手#2318の記帳誤り（$970を$790と記帳 → 差額） | $180 | **減算**（支払の過少記帳の訂正） |

調整後帳簿残高 = $81,105 + $6,240 − $2,840 − $85 − $180 = **$84,240**

調整後銀行残高（Work Tab 1）の$84,240と一致します。

tasks.title: Items Requiring Journal Entries
tasks.instruction: Which of the following reconciling items require an adjusting or correcting journal entry on Kestrel's books at December 31, Year 1? (Select all that apply.)
options: Deposit in transit of $12,650
Note receivable and interest collected by the bank
NSF check returned by the bank
Bank service charges for December
Check No. 5521 charged to the account by the bank in error
Error in recording check No. 2318
correctAnswer: Note receivable and interest collected by the bank
NSF check returned by the bank
tasks.explanation: Only reconciling items that adjust the balance per books require journal entries: the note and interest collected by the bank, the NSF check, the bank service charges, and the correction of the error in recording check No. 2318. Items that adjust the balance per bank — the deposit in transit and the check charged to the account by the bank in error — require no entries because the company's records are already correct; the bank simply has not yet recorded them or must correct its own error.
tasks.explanationJa:
仕訳が必要なのは**帳簿残高側の調整項目のみ**です。

仕訳が必要（帳簿側）:
- 銀行による手形取立（会社が未記帳）
- NSF小切手（入金が不成立）
- 銀行手数料（会社が未記帳）
- 小切手#2318の記帳誤り（会社側の誤り）

仕訳が不要（銀行側）:
- 未達預金 → 会社の帳簿は正しい。銀行が未記帳なだけ
- 銀行による他社小切手の誤引落し → 銀行側の誤りであり、銀行が訂正する。会社の帳簿は影響を受けていない

tasks.title: Journal Entry — Note Collected by Bank
tasks.instruction: Prepare the journal entry Kestrel should record at December 31, Year 1 for the note receivable and interest collected by the bank. Enter all amounts as positive numbers (in whole dollars, no commas). Enter 0 in cells that should have no amount.
tasks.explanation: The bank collected the $6,000 note from Ridgeline Cabinetworks plus $240 of interest and credited Kestrel's account for $6,240. Kestrel records the increase in cash with a debit to cash of $6,240, removes the note with a credit to notes receivable of $6,000, and recognizes the interest with a credit to interest revenue of $240.
tasks.explanationJa:
銀行がKestrelに代わって手形を取り立て、口座に$6,240を入金済みです。会社は未記帳なので、次の仕訳を記録します。

| 勘定科目 | 借方 | 貸方 |
|---|---|---|
| Cash（現金） | $6,240 | |
| Notes receivable（受取手形） | | $6,000 |
| Interest revenue（受取利息） | | $240 |

- 現金の増加: 元本と利息の合計 $6,000 + $240 = $6,240
- 受取手形の消込: 元本 $6,000
- 受取利息の認識: $240（$6,000 × 8% × 6/12 = $240）

tasks.title: Journal Entry — NSF Check, Service Charges, and Check Error
tasks.instruction: Prepare a single compound journal entry at December 31, Year 1 to record the NSF check, the December bank service charges, and the correction of the error in recording check No. 2318. Enter all amounts as positive numbers (in whole dollars, no commas). Enter 0 in cells that should have no amount.
tasks.explanation: The NSF check reinstates the receivable from Brightbay Interiors: debit accounts receivable $2,840. The December service charges are expensed: debit bank service charge expense $85. Check No. 2318 was a $970 payment of an account payable recorded as $790, so accounts payable was reduced by $180 too little and cash was credited $180 too little; the correction debits accounts payable $180. The total credit to cash is $2,840 + $85 + $180 = $3,105.
tasks.explanationJa:
3つの帳簿側調整項目（手形取立以外）をまとめた複合仕訳です。

| 勘定科目 | 借方 | 貸方 |
|---|---|---|
| Accounts receivable（売掛金） | $2,840 | |
| Bank service charge expense（支払手数料） | $85 | |
| Accounts payable（買掛金） | $180 | |
| Cash（現金） | | $3,105 |

1. **NSF小切手**: 入金が不成立となったため、顧客Brightbay Interiorsへの売掛金$2,840を復活させます
2. **銀行手数料**: 12月分$85を費用計上します
3. **小切手#2318の誤記**: 買掛金支払$970を$790と記帳していたため、買掛金の減少と現金の減少がそれぞれ$180不足 → 借方 買掛金$180 / 貸方 現金$180 で訂正します

現金の貸方合計 = $2,840 + $85 + $180 = **$3,105**

（検算）調整後帳簿残高: $81,105 + $6,240（Work Tab 4） − $3,105 = $84,240 ✓

tasks.title: Treatment of the Bank Error
tasks.instruction: How should the $1,100 check drawn by Kestrel Supply Co. and charged to Kestrel's account by the bank on December 22 be treated at December 31, Year 1?
options: Added to the balance per the bank statement in the bank reconciliation; no journal entry is required
Deducted from the balance per the bank statement in the bank reconciliation; no journal entry is required
Deducted from the balance per books, with a credit to cash
Recorded as a receivable from Kestrel Supply Co., with a debit to accounts receivable
tasks.correctAnswer: Added to the balance per the bank statement in the bank reconciliation; no journal entry is required
tasks.explanation: The bank, not Kestrel, made the error: it charged Kestrel's account for a check that Kestrel did not write. Because Kestrel's general ledger was never affected, no journal entry is required. In the reconciliation, the $1,100 is added back to the balance per the bank statement, since the bank balance is understated until the bank corrects its error in January. Kestrel has no claim against Kestrel Supply Co., so no receivable is recorded.
tasks.explanationJa:
これは**銀行側の誤り**です。Kestrelが振り出していない小切手が誤って口座から引き落とされました。

- Kestrelの帳簿はこの誤りの影響を受けていない → **仕訳は不要**
- 銀行残高は誤引落しの分だけ過少になっている → 銀行残高調整表で**銀行残高に加算**
- 誤りを訂正する義務は銀行にあり、1月の残高証明書で訂正されます
- Kestrel Supply Co.に対する債権は発生しません（Kestrelとの取引ではないため）

tasks.title: Cash Reported on the Balance Sheet
tasks.instruction: Determine the amount of cash in the operating account that Kestrel should report on its December 31, Year 1 balance sheet (in whole dollars, no commas).
tasks.explanation: The amount reported on the balance sheet for the operating account is the adjusted cash balance from the bank reconciliation. Both sections reconcile to the same amount: per bank, $86,420 + $12,650 − $15,930 + $1,100 = $84,240; per books, $81,105 + $6,240 − $2,840 − $85 − $180 = $84,240. After the adjusting and correcting entries are posted, the general ledger cash balance equals $84,240.

subject: FAR
title: Bank Reconciliation and Balance Sheet Presentation of Cash
scenario:
Ridgefield Supply Company maintains its general checking account at First National Bank. The controller is preparing the December 31, Year 1 bank reconciliation and determining the amount to report as cash and cash equivalents in the December 31, Year 1 statement of financial position.

The December bank statement is summarized in **Exhibit 1** and the general ledger cash account for December is summarized in **Exhibit 2**. A comparison of the bank statement with the accounting records produced the information in **Exhibit 3**. Other cash-related balances held by the company at December 31, Year 1 are listed in **Exhibit 4**.

Ridgefield uses the form of reconciliation that adjusts both the balance per bank and the balance per books to the correct cash balance. Round all amounts to the nearest whole dollar and ignore income taxes.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1: First National Bank — December Year 1 Statement Summary
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Balance, December 1, Year 1 | $40,150 |
| Deposits and other credits during December | 99,870 |
| Checks and other debits during December | (92,700) |
| **Balance, December 31, Year 1** | **$47,320** |

The bank statement carries the notation "Items marked CM/DM are explained on the enclosed advices."

exhibits.title: Exhibit 2: General Ledger — Cash in Bank (First National Bank)
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Balance, December 1, Year 1 | $38,600 |
| Cash receipts recorded during December | 96,400 |
| Cash disbursements recorded during December | (91,715) |
| **Balance, December 31, Year 1** | **$43,285** |

All December cash receipts were deposited in the First National Bank account, and all December disbursements were made by check from that account.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 3: Information Developed From the Comparison
exhibits.content:
1. Deposits recorded by the company on December 30 and 31 totaling $8,450 were not credited by the bank until January Year 2.
2. Checks written and recorded by the company in December totaling $12,730 had not cleared the bank as of December 31, Year 1.
3. The bank charged the account a $95 service charge for December. No entry has been made on the company's books.
4. A check for $1,240 received from customer J. Rowe and deposited in December was returned by the bank marked "NSF." The bank also charged the account a $30 NSF fee. The company intends to bill Mr. Rowe for the full amount charged to the account. No entry has been made on the company's books.
5. An electronic funds transfer of $2,400 for the December insurance premium was paid directly by the bank under a standing authorization. No entry has been made on the company's books.
6. The bank collected a $5,000 note receivable from a customer on the company's behalf, together with $250 of interest, and charged a $50 collection fee. The net amount of $5,200 was credited to the account. No entry has been made on the company's books.
7. Check No. 5148 was written for $860 to pay the December utility bill, but was recorded in the company's cash disbursements journal as $680. The bank paid the check for the correct amount.
8. A check for $1,500 written by another depositor of First National Bank was erroneously charged to Ridgefield's account in December. The bank confirmed the error and will correct it in January Year 2.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 4: Other Cash-Related Balances at December 31, Year 1
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Petty cash fund held on the premises (imprest basis, all currency and coin) | $500 |
| Certificate of deposit purchased December 1, Year 1, original maturity 90 days | 20,000 |
| U.S. Treasury note purchased November 1, Year 1, original maturity six months | 30,000 |
| Cash on deposit at Merchants Bank, legally restricted as a compensating balance under a five-year term loan | 10,000 |
| Payroll account at Second National Bank — negative balance | (3,100) |

Second National Bank is a separate financial institution, and Ridgefield has no right of offset between the payroll account and any other account. Ridgefield classifies as cash equivalents all short-term, highly liquid investments with an original maturity of three months or less.

tasks.title: Adjusted Cash Balance
tasks.instruction: Determine the correct (adjusted) cash balance of the First National Bank general checking account at December 31, Year 1. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: Balance per bank of $47,320 plus deposits in transit of $8,450, less outstanding checks of $12,730, plus the $1,500 check charged in error by the bank equals $44,540. The books side produces the same amount: $43,285 - $95 - $1,270 - $2,400 + $5,200 - $180 = $44,540.
tasks.explanationJa:
両側から同じ修正後残高に到達することを確認する。

**銀行側**
1. 銀行残高 $47,320
2. 未達預金 +$8,450
3. 未取立小切手 △$12,730
4. 他の預金者の小切手が誤って引き落とされた分 +$1,500
5. 修正後 = **$44,540**

**帳簿側**
1. 帳簿残高 $43,285
2. 銀行手数料 △$95
3. NSF小切手と手数料 △$1,270
4. 保険料の自動引落 △$2,400
5. 手形の取立入金（純額）+$5,200
6. 記帳誤り（860 - 680）△$180
7. 修正後 = **$44,540**

tasks.title: Adjusting Journal Entry on the Company's Books
tasks.instruction: Prepare the single compound December 31, Year 1 journal entry required on the company's books to bring the cash account to the correct balance. Enter whole dollars, no commas. Enter 0 in cells that should have no amount.
tasks.explanation: Only the book-side reconciling items are journalized. Cash increases by the net of the note proceeds of $5,200 less the $95 service charge, the $1,270 NSF item, the $2,400 electronic payment, and the $180 recording error, or $1,255. The NSF check and fee are charged back to the customer as a receivable of $1,270. The $95 service charge and the $50 collection fee total $145 of bank charges. The understatement of check No. 5148 adds $180 of utilities expense, the electronic transfer records $2,400 of insurance expense, and the collection removes the $5,000 note and records $250 of interest revenue.
tasks.explanationJa:
仕訳が必要なのは**帳簿側の調整項目だけ**である。未達預金・未取立小切手・銀行の誤記入は銀行側の項目なので仕訳しない。

1. Cash（純増）= 44,540 - 43,285 = **$1,255**（借方）
2. Accounts receivable = NSF小切手1,240 + NSF手数料30 = **$1,270**（借方。顧客に請求するため債権に戻す）
3. Bank service charge expense = 月次手数料95 + 取立手数料50 = **$145**（借方）
4. Utilities expense = 860 - 680 = **$180**（借方。転記誤りの追加計上）
5. Insurance expense = **$2,400**（借方。自動引落の未記帳）
6. Notes receivable = **$5,000**（貸方。取立済みのため消去）
7. Interest revenue = **$250**（貸方）

借方合計 1,255 + 1,270 + 145 + 180 + 2,400 = 5,250、貸方合計 5,000 + 250 = 5,250で一致する。

tasks.title: Items Requiring an Entry on the Books
tasks.instruction: Select every reconciling item below that requires an adjusting journal entry on the company's books at December 31, Year 1.
options: Deposits in transit of $8,450
Outstanding checks totaling $12,730
Bank service charge of $95
NSF check of $1,240 plus the related $30 NSF fee
Note collected by the bank, net proceeds of $5,200
Check for $1,500 drawn by another depositor and charged to the account in error
correctAnswer: NSF check of $1,240 plus the related $30 NSF fee
Note collected by the bank, net proceeds of $5,200
tasks.explanation: Book-side items are those the company has not yet recorded: the service charge, the returned check with its fee, and the note collected by the bank. Deposits in transit, outstanding checks, and the bank's own posting error are bank-side items that the bank will clear or correct, so no entry is made on the company's books.
tasks.explanationJa:
調整項目は「帳簿側」と「銀行側」に分けて考える。仕訳が必要なのは**会社がまだ記帳していない事実**だけである。

**仕訳が必要（帳簿側）**
- 銀行手数料 $95
- NSF小切手 $1,240 と手数料 $30
- 銀行が取り立てた手形の入金（純額 $5,200）

**仕訳が不要（銀行側）**
- 未達預金 $8,450 — 会社は既に記帳済みで、銀行が翌期に処理する
- 未取立小切手 $12,730 — 会社は既に記帳済み
- 他の預金者の小切手 $1,500 — 銀行側の誤りであり銀行が訂正する

なお保険料の自動引落と小切手の転記誤りも帳簿側の項目だが、この設問の選択肢には含まれていない。

tasks.title: Cash and Cash Equivalents Reported
tasks.instruction: Determine the amount reported as cash and cash equivalents in the December 31, Year 1 statement of financial position. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: The corrected general checking balance of $44,540, the $500 petty cash fund, and the $20,000 certificate of deposit with an original maturity of 90 days total $65,040. The six-month Treasury note, the legally restricted compensating balance, and the negative payroll account balance are excluded.
tasks.explanationJa:
現金及び現金同等物に含めるものを1件ずつ判定する。

1. 修正後の当座預金 **$44,540** — 含める
2. 小口現金 **$500** — 含める
3. 譲渡性預金（当初満期90日）**$20,000** — 当初満期3か月以内なので現金同等物に**含める**
4. 米国債（当初満期6か月）$30,000 — 当初満期が3か月超なので**含めない**
5. 使途制限のある補償残高 $10,000 — 制限付きのため**含めない**
6. 給与口座のマイナス残高 $3,100 — 別銀行で相殺権がないため**負債**として表示し、現金から控除しない

合計 = 44,540 + 500 + 20,000 = **$65,040**

tasks.title: Presentation of the Negative Payroll Account
tasks.instruction: Select how the $3,100 negative balance in the payroll account at Second National Bank should be presented in the December 31, Year 1 statement of financial position.
options: As a current liability; it is not netted against the cash held at First National Bank
As a reduction of cash and cash equivalents, because all bank accounts are aggregated
As a noncurrent liability, because the account is expected to remain negative
As a reduction of accounts payable, because the overdraft arose from vendor payments
tasks.correctAnswer: As a current liability; it is not netted against the cash held at First National Bank
tasks.explanation: A negative bank balance represents an obligation to the bank. Offsetting is permitted only when a right of offset exists, generally when the accounts are with the same institution. Because Second National Bank is a separate institution and there is no right of offset, the $3,100 is reported as a current liability.
tasks.explanationJa:
銀行口座の残高がマイナスになった場合、それは銀行に対する**債務**である。

相殺（ネッティング）が認められるのは相殺権が存在する場合、一般には同一銀行内の口座間に限られる。本問ではSecond National Bankは別の金融機関であり相殺権もないため、$3,100は現金と相殺せず**流動負債**として表示する。返済は短期に行われるため非流動負債にはならない。

tasks.title: Amounts Excluded From Cash and Cash Equivalents
tasks.instruction: Determine the total of the Exhibit 4 asset balances that are excluded from cash and cash equivalents at December 31, Year 1. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: The $30,000 Treasury note has an original maturity of six months and therefore is not a cash equivalent. The $10,000 compensating balance is legally restricted and is excluded from cash and cash equivalents. Total excluded = $40,000.
tasks.explanationJa:
Exhibit 4の**資産**のうち現金及び現金同等物から除外されるものを合計する。

1. 米国債 $30,000 — 当初満期6か月。現金同等物は「当初満期3か月以内」が要件なので除外
2. 補償残高 $10,000 — 5年ローンに紐づく法的な使途制限があるため除外（長期借入に対応するため非流動資産として表示）
3. 合計 = **$40,000**

給与口座のマイナス残高$3,100は資産ではなく負債であり、この合計には含めない。

tasks.title: Research — Restricted Cash and Current Assets
tasks.instruction: Which section of the FASB Accounting Standards Codification states that cash restricted as to withdrawal or use for other than current operations is excluded from current assets? Cite the ASC reference in XXX-XX-XX-XX format.
tasks.explanation: ASC 210-10-45-4 lists resources excluded from current assets, including cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or use for other than current operations.
tasks.explanationJa: ASC 210-10-45-4は流動資産から除外される項目を列挙しており、その中に「通常の営業以外の目的のために引出しまたは使用が制限されている現金及び現金同等物」が含まれる。本問の補償残高$10,000がこれに該当する。
